title: •He Is Not Ready
caption: He Is Not Ready (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Just after opponent draws a starting hand of 8 cards, unless you started an Objective and/or you ▲ or ▼ any other Effects, opponent must place all but 5 cards from hand in their Used Pile; re-circulate. {alter}
lore: “All his life has he looked away. To the future; to the horizon. Never his mind on where he was! Hmm? What he was doing! Hm.”
